method: Production scanner and ScoreGeometry source compiled as temporary macOS driver with UIKit/UIImage changed to AppKit/NSImage and the macOS cgImage accessor. Same PDFKit thumbnail size, Vision accurate OCR, no language correction, numeric-confidence filter and coordinate transforms. Actual local device-backup PDFs read only; no generated or copied score images saved.
scope: Five actual owned PDFs, one current bookmarked source page each, including an oversized ~5556x7738-point page. Host macOS execution; not iPad/UIKit UI or physical acceptance.
limits: Numeric OCR hints have not been checked against true measure numbers; page numbers and fingerings remain possible.
Two pages return no numeric hints, so manual confirmation is essential.
No user map is created or saved; actual end-to-end manual map acceptance remains open.
These are host OCR/render times, not page-turn latency or touch-to-frame measurements.
